content.text:
I built the cotter pin and exported it to `submission.step`. It is one valid solid, and when read back from the STEP file the volume and bounding box match the part.

**What it is:** two parallel legs, Ø10 × 60, running along Z. Their centres are 10.4 apart along Y, so they very nearly touch. A half-torus bend joins them at the top: it curls around the X axis at z = 60, with a centreline radius of 5.2 and a tube radius of 5. Overall size is about 10 × 20.4 × 70.2 (X × Y × Z).

**How it matches the reference:** my first try spaced the legs along X. In the preview the leg ends were staggered the opposite way to `composite.png`. Spacing them along Y fixed that, and all four views now match the composite for which leg end sits lower and which way the bend opens. I estimated the proportions (leg diameter to total height, about 1:7) from pixel sizes in the image. I didn't fit them more precisely than that.

The latest four-view render is in `preview.png`, and you can watch the model at http://127.0.0.1:8772/#part.FCStd.
